chunks: Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him, “If a free woman is married to a slave, how many divorces can he pronounce against her?” So he said:
ʿAlī عليه السلام said: “Divorce and the waiting period are determined according to the women.”

key_terms.الطَّلَاقُ: divorce as a legal dissolution of marriage
key_terms.الْحُرَّةُ: a free woman, as opposed to a bondwoman
key_terms.الْعِدَّةُ: the waiting period observed after divorce
key_terms.بِالنِّسَاءِ: according to the women; determined with reference to the woman’s status
key_terms.يُطَلِّقُهَا: he divorces her; pronounces divorce against her

ai.seo_question: In Shia fiqh, is divorce and ʿiddah determined by the status of the husband or the woman?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning divorce and the waiting period in a marriage involving a free woman and a slave husband. It states that the governing consideration for divorce and ʿiddah in this case is the status of the woman.
